physicalNotes: Radius 0.27504684 Jupiter radii from Bonfanti et al. 2021 (2021A&A...646A.157B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021A&A...646A.157B/abstract): 19,663.6 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.0306 Jupiter masses (the NASA Exoplanet Archive's calculated value (M-R relationship, its Chen & Kipping 2017 mass-radius relationship): a model, not a measurement, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/pscp_calc.html) times JPL's Jupiter GM.
